points: Led 9 engineers building the voice agent platform end to end: Whisper speech recognition, LangGraph agents calling MCP tools, and ElevenLabs speech. Round trips got down to 650 ms, fast enough for callers to interrupt naturally.
Served the models on vLLM (continuous batching, paged attention, KV-cache reuse) with INT8 quantization on autoscaling GPUs, cutting response time per turn by 45%.
Built FAISS-backed retrieval so the agent answers from company knowledge instead of guessing, and led prompt-injection and jailbreak testing before launch.
Ran self-hosted Kubeflow pipelines and OpenTelemetry across Kubernetes, Kafka and WebRTC: 300+ concurrent calls, 15,000+ calls a day, 99.9% uptime.
Building an AutoML system that handles data cleaning, feature engineering, hyperparameter tuning and model selection with ensembles.
Agent workflows on LangGraph, LangChain and the OpenAI API, with tool calling, state tracking and dynamic routing.
Distributed pipelines with MLflow, Docker and Kubernetes on AWS over 10TB+ of medical imaging and genetic data.
Built a rules + ML system that routes and escalates client queries to the right partner channel, cutting human involvement by 70%.

Led a 4-person team on a RASA chatbot: BERT intent classification quantized and optimized with TensorRT, Pinecone search over past resolutions, and Whisper voice input. Complaint resolution went from 48 hours to 6.
Deployed the pipeline on AWS SageMaker with automatic retraining triggers and OpenTelemetry tracing.
TypeScript admin console on AWS (EC2, load balancer, DynamoDB) with auto-scaling and health-check failover: 99.2% uptime through traffic spikes.
GitLab CI/CD with automated tests, canary checks and blue-green deploys took releases from 4 hours to 25 minutes.
Compound indexes, covered queries and rewritten aggregation pipelines cut MongoDB query time by 73% on hot endpoints.

Owned the vehicle scheduling and dispatch module of transWARE.us (React + Node.js), with GraphQL APIs wiring booking, dispatch and inventory into QuickBooks and payments. SQL tuning and Redis caching cut query times by 22%.
Moved legacy JavaScript to non-blocking I/O and migrated 15 REST endpoints to GraphQL: 30% less CPU, 35% smaller payloads.
Jest tests and GitLab CI + Docker pipelines for a team of 5: coverage from 40% to 78%, deploys from 85 to 30 minutes.

Led 2 interns building a Bluetooth (BLE) remote camera system: Kotlin app, Express.js backend and Vue.js dashboard synced through Firebase and WebSockets. A leaner pairing protocol cut connection latency by 35%.
